official.deadline_note: APU states the full set of scholarship documents must be received on or before this date; awards are allocated on a first come first served basis.
official.status_note: APU's awards page publishes the Application Deadline for this International Scholarship & Merit Awards as 31 October 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: All awards leading to fees rebate/discount are limited to course/tuition fees only; all other fees and expenses are borne by the award holder.
benefits: APU Merit Award of 30%, 20% or 10% tuition fee discount according to pre-university qualification score
Awarded on a yearly basis and renewable upon meeting a minimum CGPA of 2.50 at the end of each academic year
eligibility: New international student applicants; the award is applicable to all countries/nationalities
Qualifying pre-university results: A-Levels, O-Levels/IGCSE, IB Diploma or IB MYP
Applicants with sports excellence (participation at the Olympics, SEA Games, Youth Olympics, Asian Games, World Cups or Commonwealth Games) can be considered case by case
requirements: Awards are given on a first come first served basis and may be secured by paying Application & Processing Fees of RM 3,600 (approx. USD 950)
Applicants must meet the minimum entry requirements and maintain a CGPA of 2.50 to enjoy the fee awards in subsequent years; failure results in the award being terminated/suspended
Applications with incomplete or missing information and documents are not considered
All awards are at the absolute discretion of the Scholarships & Merit Awards Committee
documents: Completed APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards online application form
Educational documents/certificates evidencing the qualifying pre-university results
The full set of scholarship application documents received on or before the deadline
selection_criteria: Pre-university qualification scores set the award band: AAA/8-9 O-Level or IGCSE As/IB Diploma 34+/IB MYP 48+ = 30%; AAB/6-7 As/IB 30-33/MYP 44-47 = 20%; ABB-AAC/4-5 As/IB 26-29/MYP 35-43 = 10%
Sports excellence at international events considered on a case to case basis
coverage: 10% to 30% tuition fee rebate/discount depending on qualification score
Awards limited to course/tuition fees only; registration fees, accommodation fees, deposits, partner university fees, resit or retake fees, living and travel expenses are borne by the award holder
application_method: Complete the APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards online form on the awards page
Ensure the full set of required documents is received on or before 31 October 2026
official.application_route: Submit the online Merit Awards application form on APU's international students scholarships page with the full document set before 31 October 2026
official.international_eligibility: Available to new international students of any nationality
official.duration: Merit Awards are awarded on a yearly basis and are renewable each academic year while a minimum CGPA of 2.50 is maintained
official.description: Asia Pacific University Malaysia offers new international students of all nationalities wide-ranging fee Awards leading to rebates/discounts of 10% to 30% of tuition, determined by their pre-university qualification results and renewable each year provided a minimum CGPA of 2.50 is maintained.
official.program_type: University merit scholarship / tuition fee award

verification.notes: Verified on APU's official awards page: the 10/20/30% discount table, CGPA 2.50 renewal rule, RM 3,600 application and processing fee, tuition-only coverage with an explicit exclusion list, and the published 31 October 2026 deadline; no monetary award value or English requirement is stated.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an automatic tuition discount rather than a competitive scholarship: your actual A-Level, O-Level/IGCSE, IB Diploma or IB MYP results decide whether you receive 10%, 20% or 30% off tuition, and awards go first come first served. Budget for the RM 3,600 (approx. USD 950) application and processing fee to secure the award, and keep your CGPA at 2.50 or above or the discount is terminated after the first year. The discount covers tuition only, so registration, accommodation, deposits, resit fees and living costs stay with you, and it cannot be used at overseas partner universities.
applicant_utility.best_fit: New international applicants with already-achieved strong A-Level, IGCSE/O-Level or IB results who are starting an APU undergraduate programme in Malaysia.
application_readiness_checklist: Work out which band your actual results fall into (AAA/AAB/ABB-AAC; 8-9/6-7/4-5 As; IB 34+/30-33/26-29; IB MYP 48+/44-47/35-43)
Prepare the RM 3,600 (approx. USD 950) application and processing fee
Assemble final/actual result certificates rather than predicted grades
Submit the online form with the full document set well before 31 October 2026 given first-come-first-served allocation
Confirm your programme is taught at APU in Malaysia, since awards do not apply at overseas partner universities
common_rejection_risks: Submitting predicted rather than actual results
Incomplete or missing information and documents, which APU states will not be considered
Applying late in a first-come-first-served allocation and missing the remaining awards
Letting CGPA fall below 2.50, which terminates or suspends the award
Assuming the award covers registration, accommodation, deposits or resit fees
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: 70-90% of tuition plus registration fees, accommodation, deposits, partner university fees where applicable, resit or retake fees, and living and travel expenses
document_audit: APU requires the full set of scholarship documents by the deadline, not just the form alone
Educational certificates must evidence the actual results that set the award band
Even a qualifying score does not guarantee an award, which is at the committee's absolute discretion
alerts: The deadline is 31 October 2026 and awards are first come first served, so early submission matters
Sports excellence claims are only considered case by case and are not a guaranteed route
Awards are not transferable or exchangeable for cash
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Fill the online Merit Awards form on the APU page, submit actual result certificates and the full document set, and pay the RM 3,600 application and processing fee to secure the award.
